messages:
jess: Heads-up — Zephyr tenant hitting 429s on Dedicated pool for ~15m. Also seeing p95 token latency jump. They said it started after they increased batch_size in prod.
mike: Can you paste a request/response? Any X-RateLimit headers?
jess: here's a repro from their curl:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-neo-8b","input":"hello","max_tokens":1024}'
```
Response:
```http
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 600000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 167
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"rate_limited","message":"per-tenant quota exceeded"}
```
jess: note Limit looks big but Remaining is 0 immediately on burst.
ops-bot: autoscaler: pool-dedicated-42 scaled up +1 at 2930456905, scaled down -1 at 2930457020 (policy: stable-throughput)
cheng: looking at quota config for Zephyr. They were provisioned with tokens_per_minute: 600000 in the dedicated quota object, but our runtime enforces requests_per_minute for burst window checks. That mismatch means token budget is ignored for short bursts -> quick 429s.
mike: ugh — so the denominator mismatch. We recently added tokens_per_minute as an optional param but didn't wire conversion for dedicated pools.
jess: can we hotfix to convert tokens -> requests using average tokens_per_request heuristic for that tenant? customer needs immediate relief.
cheng: quick mitigation: temporarily relax strict burst enforcement on their pool (set burst_threshold to 0.0 -> permissive) while we ship proper conversion. I'll apply and reload policy.
mike: creating a small config change PR to translate tokens_per_minute -> requests_per_minute using tenant default of 150 tokens/request. Also adding validation to reject mixed-unit quotas.
support-bot: ticket #SUP-18432 created and linked to customer's case. Notifying success channel.
jess: applied mitigation at 2930457002 — customer reports errors dropped and p95 back to normal. Will follow up with a change window to deploy the conversion.
mike: postmortem action items: 1) add schema validation for quota unit fields 2) add e2e test for dedicated pool enforcement 3) run a sweep for any tenants with tokens_* but served by request-based limiter.
cheng: noted. marking thread resolved but leaving ticket open for rollout.
